data.review_needs: Priority candidate; choose a project with public records and consent-sensitive review.

data.title: P2P Foundation Wiki Stewardship and Currency Review
data.context: Examine how the large wiki is currently maintained, corrected, sourced, archived, and used by communities and researchers.
data.what_returns_to_commons: Direct comparator for the Toolkit's own maintenance and public-use challenges.
data.notes: What to capture: editors; update cadence; page status; source quality; dead links; governance; contribution rights; forks; exports; current usage.
data.review_needs: Candidate; current stewardship information should be confirmed with maintainers.

data.title: Participatory Data Stewardship Pilot Follow-Up
data.context: Review one data-stewardship pilot beyond its initial framework or launch stage.
data.what_returns_to_commons: Tests whether participatory data institutions survive beyond pilots and preserve community power.
data.notes: What to capture: legal form, community authority, value model, infrastructure, participation, financing, scaling, exit, disputes and current operation.
data.review_needs: Candidate; implementation evidence may be incomplete.

data.title: Polis Moderation and Statement-Governance Record
data.context: Document one live conversation's moderation policy, rejected statements, labor, appeals, participant feedback, and effect on consensus outputs.
data.what_returns_to_commons: Makes hidden governance visible and tests structural-integrity claims around automated deliberation.
data.notes: What to capture: moderators, criteria, statement queue, rejection reasons, timing, abuse handling, transparency, appeals, model effects, and lessons.
data.review_needs: Potentially sensitive; protect participant privacy and moderator safety.

data.title: Sembradoras de Esperanza Women-Led School Case
data.context: Develop a women-led movement-school case from Chile.
data.what_returns_to_commons: Adds a women-led territorial education case beyond umbrella declarations.
data.notes: What to capture: governance, pedagogy, seed and agroecology practice, Indigenous/rural women's authority, care labor, participants, outcomes and continuity.

data.title: University Indigenous Data Governance Review
data.context: Use the GIDA university communiqué to assess one institution's repositories, research workflows or AI/data practices.
data.what_returns_to_commons: Creates an institution-level implementation case beyond individual research ethics.
data.notes: What to capture: data holdings, decision authority, open-data defaults, AI use, repatriation, benefit, Indigenous governance roles, correction and accountability.
data.review_needs: Requires institution and affected Indigenous perspectives.

data.title: Care-Health-Food Knowledge Confluence
data.what_it_is: Convene ancestral knowledge holders, community health practitioners, rural organizers and public audiences around bodies, food and care.
data.potential_uses: Community health learning, care commons and agroecology programs.
data.dependencies: Medical-safety boundaries, consent, attribution, cultural authority and referral to public health systems.
data.tradeoffs: Traditional knowledge may be romanticized, medicalized or extracted without community benefit.

data.title: Classification Power and Positionality Record
data.what_it_is: Attach important categories and taxonomies to their authors, purposes, assumptions, affected groups, exclusions, contestation and revision rights.
data.potential_uses: Ontology, tags, review lenses, people records, AI classification and public navigation.
data.dependencies: Category steward, source lineage, affected-party review, dispute process and change log.
data.tradeoffs: Documentation alone does not redistribute power or eliminate harmful classification.

data.title: Cluster-Based Duplicate Resolution
data.what_it_is: Resolve duplicates within bounded source-system clusters before attempting database-wide normalization.
data.dependencies: Aliases, object typing, primary sources, domain reviewers, duplicate queue.
data.tradeoffs: Local decisions can create inconsistent identities across clusters without later reconciliation.

data.title: Contextual Integrity Privacy Crosswalk
data.what_it_is: Review personal-information flows by actors, attributes, transmission principles, context, exit, voice, and community governance.
data.potential_uses: AI-assisted knowledge systems, social archives, health/data commons, civic platforms, contributor records.
data.dependencies: Privacy expertise, data-flow mapping, community norms, threat analysis, correction and deletion mechanisms.
data.tradeoffs: Framework use can appear rigorous while missing lived risk or unequal bargaining power.

data.title: Funding-to-Evidence Pipeline
data.what_it_is: Connect project discovery and capital allocation to milestone reporting, analytics, domain evidence, implementation memory and later review.
data.potential_uses: Funding programs, public-goods portfolios, ecological projects, open-source projects and local initiatives.
data.dependencies: Shared project identifiers, source lineage, reporting expectations, evidence fields, correction paths and review roles.
data.tradeoffs: Can create surveillance or reporting burdens, privilege easily measured work, and imply that linked data proves impact.

data.title: Governance Prototyping Through Roleplay and Games
data.what_it_is: Use structured games to surface roles, obligations, incentives, authority, conflicts, and possible agreements before real deployment.
data.potential_uses: Working-group formation, cross-community coordination, governance onboarding, scenario testing, and design workshops.
data.dependencies: Facilitation, participant diversity, clear learning goals, documentation, debrief, and real decision pathways.
data.tradeoffs: Games may privilege confident participants, simplify power, create false agreement, or be mistaken for actual governance.

data.title: Meta-Agenda Setting Through Polis
data.what_it_is: Use Polis to let participants help decide which future issue should receive a full deliberative process.
data.potential_uses: Participatory agenda setting, community priorities, program planning.
data.dependencies: Clear eligibility, topic scoping, moderation, transparency, institutional capacity to act on selected issues.
data.tradeoffs: Popular or well-networked topics may crowd out urgent, marginalized, technical, or legally constrained issues.

data.title: Movement-Generated Concept Dictionary
data.what_it_is: Develop multilingual, attributed concepts from movements and communities while preserving differences, contested meanings and source contexts.
data.potential_uses: Ontology design, review lenses, translation, AI vocabulary and public learning.
data.dependencies: Community authorship, language resources, version ownership, multiple definitions and refusal of forced equivalence.
data.tradeoffs: A global dictionary can standardize living concepts or privilege groups with greater writing and translation capacity.

data.title: Movement-Owned Education Source-System Model
data.what_it_is: Treat a political school as a linked system of pedagogy, movement governance, physical infrastructure, archives, partnerships, maintenance and territorial practice.
data.potential_uses: Knowledge-commons design, steward training, local-node education, movement memory.
data.dependencies: Movement authority, educator and participant review, funding, accessibility, curricula and maintenance ownership.
data.tradeoffs: Can romanticize political formation, erase internal disagreement or extract curricula from movement context.

data.title: Multi-Format Knowledge Record
data.what_it_is: Allow one record or collection to expose concise plain language, full detail, structured data, audio/transcript and visual alternatives without treating one format as canonical for all users.
data.potential_uses: Public collections, implementation memory, source-system cards and educational views.
data.dependencies: Content model, editorial workflow, accessibility standards, version synchronization.
data.tradeoffs: Increases maintenance burden and can create inconsistent representations.

data.title: Open Transcript and Decision-Memory Layer
data.what_it_is: Publish searchable transcripts, meeting context and decision materials so participation and policy processes remain inspectable and reusable.
data.potential_uses: Implementation memory, governance review, source-system stewardship and public accountability.
data.dependencies: Consent, redaction, accessible summaries, retention rules, source integrity and correction pathways.
data.tradeoffs: Radical transparency can chill participation, expose sensitive actors or privilege those able to process large archives.

data.title: Pledge-Based Civic Membership
data.what_it_is: Use a public pledge and shared civic responsibility as a cultural entry point before deeper contribution or co-governance.
data.potential_uses: Values-oriented networks, local chapters, commons participation, contributor onboarding.
data.dependencies: Accessible language, consent, concrete practices, review and accountability paths, non-coercive exit.
data.tradeoffs: Symbolic commitment may substitute for enforceable governance or exclude people who share goals but reject the framing.

data.title: Product Recognition vs Commons Outcome Crosswalk
data.what_it_is: Separate product-quality awards and market recognition from cooperative governance, livelihood, ecological and public-value outcomes.
data.potential_uses: Claims review, communications, funder reports and implementation memory.
data.dependencies: Award criteria, production data and distinct social/ecological evidence.
data.tradeoffs: May undervalue symbolic recognition or over-formalize community achievements.

data.title: Southern Digital Justice Comparison Lens
data.what_it_is: Compare digital systems using regional political economy, colonial history, gender, labor, publicness, rights, infrastructure and community power rather than importing one universal responsible-tech frame.
data.potential_uses: AI governance, data policy, DPI, platform regulation, public-interest technology and source-system review.
data.dependencies: Regional expertise, multilingual sources, affected-party participation and context-specific evidence.
data.tradeoffs: The category 'Global South' can flatten major political, cultural and economic differences.

data.title: Worker-Ownership and Power Review
data.what_it_is: Assess legal ownership, voting, board power, management, algorithm control, work rules, surplus allocation, data rights, grievance processes, and exit rights separately.
data.potential_uses: Platform-coop review, public-goods builder support, cooperative technology assessment.
data.dependencies: Governance documents, worker interviews, financial structure, labor-process data, affected-worker review.
data.tradeoffs: Can overburden small co-ops; formal documentation may diverge from rules-in-use.

data.title: Boundary — Assentamento Che Guevara — Casserengue

Do not present community data, monitoring specifics, or ancestral-knowledge claims as independently verified without affected-party (Achuar / Sharamentsa) review and consent.
data.notes: Covers candidate 03-resource-biocultural-jaguar-credits-sharamentsa.yaml (this work order) — high-risk trigger per ingest skill.

data.title: Boundary — Data Against Feminicide

data.notes: Covers candidate 18-resource-data-against-feminicide.yaml (this work order) — high-risk trigger per ingest skill.

data.title: Boundary — Revista Sem Terrinha
data.consent_note: Publication is produced for and features children (Sem Terrinha / MST youth organizing). Do not extract, quote, or reproduce child-authored or child-featuring content without age-appropriate consent, safeguarding, and representation review.
data.notes: Covers candidate 27-resource-revista-sem-terrinha.yaml (this work order) — high-risk trigger per ingest skill.

data.notes: Why add: Evidence of cross-school learning and shared method development. Status/Caution: Event evidence; downstream research use and participant outcomes unknown

data.title: Amanda Luz

data.title: Citizen Initiatives

data.notes: Why add: Adds participant-initiated agenda setting. Status/Caution: Thresholds and response obligations vary Edge case: Crosswalk marks "Participatory space" Other/Review (manual); no clean bullet fit — mapped to resource as a platform-mechanism feature.

data.notes: Why add: High-value bridge to public-goods funding, grantee reporting and implementation memory. Status/Caution: Using templates or dashboards does not establish fair funding, valid evidence or grantee capacity Edge case: Crosswalk marks "Standard / grants obligation architecture" Other/Review (manual); mapped to resource (protocol/standard bucket).

data.title: Data Against Feminicide
data.summary: Feminist participatory action research network examining how activists and civil society collect, maintain and use data about gender-related killings.
data.source_lineage: Data + Feminism Lab / ILDA / Feminicidio Uruguay | https://dusp.mit.edu/projects/data-against-feminicide
data.notes: Why add: Strong implementation branch for community data labor, missing official data, transnational collaboration, safety and classification politics. Status/Caution: Highly sensitive domain; do not copy names, locations or case data without project and affected-community safeguards T4 gap: framework has no dedicated organization/network entity schema; mapped to resource per ingest instructions.

data.title: Design Justice Network Activities and Workshop Resources
data.summary: Adaptable activities prompting participants to examine who participated, who was harmed and who benefited in design processes.
data.notes: Why add: Direct practical input for Toolkit review sessions and implementation retrospectives. Status/Caution: Activities are prompts, not comprehensive assessments or certification.

data.title: Digital Justice Project
data.summary: Initiative reframing emerging techno-social systems from a Southern feminist and social-justice perspective.
data.notes: Why add: Useful source for political economy, data extractivism and development sovereignty. Status/Caution: Project framing is advocacy-informed and should be cited as such

data.title: Ellie Rennie
data.summary: Research director and contributor associated with Govbase, KOI Pond, D20 Governance, MetagovDAO, and digital-governance research.
data.notes: Why add: Bridge across community research, knowledge infrastructure, and governance experiments. Status/Caution: Verify current roles before public use. T4 gap: framework has no dedicated person entity schema; mapped to resource per ingest instructions.

data.title: GHG and Co-Benefits in Watershed Carbon
data.summary: Credit framework connecting watershed nature-based or green-infrastructure activities with avoided emissions and ecological co-benefits.
data.notes: Why add: Bridge between water infrastructure, carbon accounting, and ecological co-benefits. Status/Caution: Avoided-emissions baselines and co-benefit claims need independent scrutiny

data.title: GIVeconomy
data.summary: Token-enabled ecosystem connecting staking, donor rewards, project boosting, and participation.
data.notes: Why add: Core Giveth mechanism family. Status/Caution: Source-linked; components change over time

data.title: Governing Medical Knowledge Commons
data.summary: 2017 collection of fifteen cases involving researchers, medical professionals, patients, data, innovation, and shared medical knowledge.
data.notes: Why add: Adds health, patient, research-data, and innovation-governance cases. Status/Caution: Medical and patient data require heightened privacy, consent, and affected-party care.

data.title: IALA-PR
data.summary: Institute accompanying agroecological initiatives through participatory action research, resources, training and land-access work.
data.notes: Why add: Adds contemporary infrastructure and land-governance branch. Status/Caution: Do not confuse with CLOC IALA network schools without explicit affiliation evidence T4 gap: framework has no dedicated organization entity schema; mapped to resource per ingest instructions.

data.title: La Vía Campesina TV
data.summary: Movement video archive containing documentaries, interviews, mobilizations, training and regional voices.
data.notes: Why add: Adds multilingual audiovisual field memory and people discovery. Status/Caution: Archive metadata and translations vary; media visibility is not authority or evidence of representativeness

data.title: Nyéléni Declaration on Food Sovereignty (2007)
data.summary: Declaration produced by more than 500 representatives from more than 80 countries at the first global forum.
data.notes: Why add: Foundational movement-authored articulation of food sovereignty and cross-constituency alliance. Status/Caution: Political declaration; preserve constituency authorship and historical context without building a historical database layer

data.title: Regen KOI MCP
data.summary: Model Context Protocol interface exposing a large Regen ecosystem knowledge collection to AI assistants and agent workflows.
data.notes: Why add: Direct comparison for Toolkit agent access, source retrieval, and knowledge-query infrastructure. Status/Caution: Document counts and system capabilities are time-sensitive; retrieval does not equal review or truth

data.title: Remote Access Archive
data.summary: Crowdsourced community archive documenting disabled people’s remote participation, learning, work, sociality and organizing before and during the COVID-19 era.
data.notes: Why add: Direct model for community archives, accessible metadata, contributor knowledge and remote participation memory. Status/Caution: Community archive; reuse must preserve contributor context and access practices

data.title: Revista Sem Terrinha
data.summary: Movement publication for children connected to education, culture, rights and Sem Terrinha organizing.
data.notes: Why add: Adds child-centered knowledge production and educational media. Status/Caution: Child-focused content requires age, consent, safeguarding and representation review

data.title: Transnational Citizens’ Assemblies
data.summary: Curated collection of citizens’ assemblies addressing issues and publics across national borders.
data.notes: Why add: Relevant to multi-level governance and the scaling-deliberation questions raised by DemocracyNext. Status/Caution: Collection coverage depends on editorial selection and available entries.

data.title: Agroecología en Puerto Rico Archive
data.what_it_curates: Farm videos; seed-saving demonstrations; farmer stories; markets and links; school agriculture; production and processing practices; project and license pages.
data.why_it_matters: Collaborative video and illustration project created by Juan Manuel Pagán Teitelbaum, Mariolga Reyes Cruz and Organización Boricuá, documenting farms, seed saving, markets, school gardens and ecological practices in Puerto Rico.
data.caution: Archive is historical and selective. Public educational access does not prove current farm status or consent for new AI uses beyond the stated Creative Commons terms.

data.title: Algorithmic Justice League (AJL)
data.what_it_curates: Gender Shades; AI harms resources; Freedom Flyers; Comply to Fly report; harm reporting; research, campaigns, exhibitions and education; founder Joy Buolamwini.
data.why_it_matters: Movement-oriented research, advocacy, art and public education organization focused on exposing AI harms and biases, elevating impacted communities and advancing accountable technology.
data.caution: AJL materials are advocacy and research sources, not universal audits of all AI systems. Performance bias is only one form of harm; accuracy improvements do not resolve surveillance, power or legitimacy.

data.title: Allo.Capital
data.what_it_curates: Resources library; Onchain Capital Allocation Handbook Vols. 1–2; Ethereum Localism; Grassroots Economics; historical materials.
data.why_it_matters: Useful for distinctive handbooks, localism and grassroots economics resources, and historical Allo Protocol / Grants Stack context.
data.caution: Avoid duplicate mechanism deepening. Distinguish current publishing from historical software products.

data.title: ANAMURI
data.what_it_curates: Who we are; board; Indigenous, salaried-worker, producer and youth branches; congresses; seed campaign; ethical tribunal; formation; multimedia; books, booklets and bulletins.
data.why_it_matters: Chile-wide autonomous organization of rural and Indigenous women spanning agricultural workers, seasonal workers, producers, herders, artisans, artisanal fishers, cultural workers and regional organizations.
data.caution: National scope and public visibility do not establish equal regional, Indigenous, worker, youth or local decision power. Roles and reach are date-sensitive and organizer-reported.

data.title: ANAMURI Publications and Multimedia Archive
data.what_it_curates: Publications; books; cartillas; seasonal-worker materials; multimedia; congress archives; youth media; seed-campaign documents.
data.why_it_matters: ANAMURI-controlled collection of books, booklets, bulletins, triptychs, radio clips, audiovisual materials, congress records and campaign documents.
data.caution: Public availability does not equal unrestricted reuse or AI-training permission. Older items require date and context labels; archive completeness is unknown.

data.title: ANAMURI
data.what_it_curates: Official site, publications, congress materials, school documentation and campaign pages.
data.why_it_matters: National women-led rural and Indigenous organization in Chile with congresses, publications, seed work, agroecology education, youth and territorial branches.
data.caution: National representational claims need territorial verification; roles and governance are date-sensitive; official sources do not prove outcomes. | Workflow status: Selected for full deepening

data.title: Artizen / artizen.fund
data.what_it_curates: Projects; Artifacts; sponsorship; curated Funds; Endowment; match multiples; Boosts; Boost Points; ART; interviews and newsletter.
data.why_it_matters: Extends public-goods funding into art, science, technology, and culture through creator fundraising, curated Funds, an Endowment, matching, Artifacts, and community Boosts.
data.caution: Sales, sponsorship, boosts, rankings, and allocations are funding or attention signals, not proof of quality or public benefit.

data.title: Association for Progressive Communications (APC)
data.what_it_curates: Network members and associates; community networks; feminist internet; environmental justice; digital rights; policy advocacy; publications; grants; podcasts; events; governance and people.
data.why_it_matters: Membership-based global network connecting digital justice, feminist internet, environmental justice, community networks, access, rights, policy and movement infrastructure, with strong participation across the Global South.
data.caution: APC is a network, not a single representative voice. Distinguish APC-authored positions from member, partner and community perspectives; preserve regional and affected-community authority.

data.title: ATC Nicaragua / IALA Ixim Ulew
data.what_it_curates: CLOC formation materials, ATC communications, school records and regional youth processes.
data.why_it_matters: Nicaraguan rural-worker/peasant organization and agroecology school branch within the CLOC IALA network.
data.caution: Current governance, political independence, participant outcomes and maintenance require careful multi-source review. | Workflow status: Selected

data.title: Certificado Ecológico Boricuá Archive
data.what_it_curates: Certification principles; farmer and consumer participation; ecological production criteria; local-market orientation; links to training and brigades.
data.why_it_matters: Historical documentation of a Puerto Rican participatory ecological certificate developed by farmers and consumers for small farmers selling directly in local markets.
data.caution: Current operating status, governance, inspection practice, dispute handling and recognition are not established by the archived page. Treat as a historical implementation lead until steward-reviewed.

data.title: CLOC–La Vía Campesina
data.what_it_curates: VIII Continental Congress; Caribbean, Central American and South American regions; women, youth and diversity articulations; IALA network; communications schools; Voz Campesina; declarations; campaigns; member organizations.
data.why_it_matters: Coordinates peasant, Indigenous, Afro-descendant, fisher, rural-worker and allied organizations across three continental regions while linking food sovereignty, agrarian reform, agroecology, feminism, youth, diversity and anti-imperialist organizing.
data.caution: Do not treat CLOC as one uniform voice or assume continental declarations represent identical positions, power or implementation across all member organizations. Scale figures are organizer-reported and date-sensitive.

data.title: Computational Democracy Project / Polis + vTaiwan
data.what_it_curates: Polis; hosted and self-hosted infrastructure; research; case studies; vTaiwan process; g0v lineage; policy examples.
data.why_it_matters: Open-source collective-intelligence infrastructure maintained by CompDem, paired with vTaiwan’s hybrid process and g0v civic-tech lineage.
data.caution: Tool performance and policy influence must be assessed case by case; participant recruitment and institutional response shape results.

data.title: Coordination Structural Integrity Suite / Durgadas standards family
data.steward: Coordination Structural Integrity Suite / Durgadas standards family
data.what_it_curates: Ten-standard Coordination Structural Integrity Suite; CRAFT meta-standard; CROSS, WALKRI and GRAIN; Dimensional Frame Language; prompts, skills, rubrics, dashboards, schemas and builder tools.
data.why_it_matters: Open standards, prompts, rubrics, schemas and implementation tools for making coordination structures, evaluation chains, grant obligations and data-capture instruments more explicit, auditable and non-harming.
data.caution: Referencing a standard is not conformance. Most materials are maintainer-authored and require independent testing, domain review, usability evidence and affected-party review before consequential deployment.

data.title: Critical Design Lab
data.what_it_curates: Remote Access Archive; Contra* podcast; research projects; protocols; exhibitions; critical design scholarship; accessibility and remote participation practices.
data.why_it_matters: International collaborative of disabled designers, researchers, artists and cultural workers developing critical disability design, crip technoscience, remote-access archives and experimental protocols.
data.caution: Research and design artifacts are context-specific. Experimental and community knowledge should not be converted into universal compliance rules without disabled-led review.

data.title: Data + Feminism Lab / Data Feminism
data.what_it_curates: Data Feminism book and seven principles; Data + Feminism Lab; participatory research; Data Against Feminicide; Audit the Streets; feminist data methods; Data Feminism for AI.
data.why_it_matters: Research and practice ecosystem examining data science as power and developing intersectional feminist approaches to data collection, classification, analysis, visualization, labor and community collaboration.
data.caution: Feminist framing is not a substitute for affected-community authority, Indigenous governance, disability justice, labor rights or domain-specific evidence. Do not treat the seven principles as certification.

data.title: Decidim / Metadecidim
data.what_it_curates: Decidim framework; participatory spaces, components and phases; processes, assemblies, initiatives and conferences; proposals, meetings, debates, budgeting, accountability, sortitions and verification; GraphQL API and modular architecture; Metadecidim community, LAB, Decidim.GOV, Association regulation and sustainability processes; Barcelona, Som Energia, Mérida and cooperative implementations.
data.why_it_matters: A mature free/libre participatory-democracy platform and technopolitical community that connects software, public institutions, civic organizations, participatory processes, accountability, documentation, and community governance.
data.caution: Software and activity metrics do not guarantee democratic quality. Each deployment needs review of authority, recruitment, access, facilitation, verification, privacy, implementation, maintenance and affected-party outcomes.

data.title: Democracy at Work Institute
data.what_it_curates: Resource Guide; publications; cooperative-growth ecosystems; employee-ownership transitions; state-of-the-sector research; tools; services; developer and worker-owner guidance.
data.why_it_matters: National U.S. field-building organization created by the U.S. Federation of Worker Cooperatives to support worker-cooperative development, especially in economically and socially marginalized communities.
data.caution: Primarily U.S.-focused. Worker-cooperative resources should be contextualized by jurisdiction, sector, race, gender, immigration status, financing, and actual worker control.

data.title: Design Justice Network
data.what_it_curates: Design Justice Principles; signatories and members; Steering Committee; Working Groups; Local Nodes; membership model; zines; workshops; Care Pod; events and reflections.
data.why_it_matters: A living network, principles framework, resource commons and governance practice focused on shifting design power toward people most affected by design decisions.
data.caution: Signing principles or joining the network is not certification. Design justice cannot be reduced to a checklist, workshop brand, demographic representation, or consultation after core decisions are fixed.

data.title: Disability Visibility Project
data.what_it_curates: Blog and guest essays; Disability Visibility anthology; podcast archive; oral histories; resource guides; political and cultural commentary; community campaigns.
data.why_it_matters: Online community founded by Alice Wong to create, share and amplify disability media, culture, first-person knowledge and cross-movement analysis.
data.caution: First-person testimony is essential evidence but should not be generalized beyond its scope. Publishing visibility is not the same as representation of all disabled communities.

data.title: Donella Meadows Project / Academy for Systems Change
data.steward: Donella Meadows Project / Academy for Systems Change
data.what_it_curates: Donella Meadows archive; Thinking in Systems; Leverage Points; Dancing with Systems; indicators; visioning; systems resources; learning journeys; field stories.
data.why_it_matters: Preserves Donella Meadows’s writings and applies systems thinking through current learning programs, tools, field stories and practitioner education.
data.caution: The archive is steward-authored and legacy-oriented. Systems concepts are lenses, not neutral predictions or universal intervention recipes.

data.title: Energy Democracy Project
data.what_it_curates: Co-created playbooks, policy resources, campaigns and organizer-developed tools
data.why_it_matters: United States with transferable movement resources
data.caution: US-centered and advocacy-oriented; distinguish proposals and movement strategy from implemented outcomes | Workflow status: Selected in final bounded source-system expansion

data.title: Escola Nacional Florestan Fernandes (ENFF)
data.what_it_curates: Political formation; pedagogy; courses; territorial-development graduate education; movement-university partnerships; international exchanges; culture and memory; supporter networks; maintenance campaigns.
data.why_it_matters: MST-founded popular-education institution in Guararema, collectively built and maintained to support political, technical and international formation for MST and allied movements.
data.caution: Public participation and reach counts are organizer-reported. ENFF should not substitute for decentralized territorial education or be treated as representing every movement voice.

data.title: Escuela Nacional de Agroecología Sembradoras de Esperanza
data.steward: Escuela Nacional de Agroecología Sembradoras de Esperanza
data.what_it_curates: School materials; seminars; agroecology and seed encounters; women’s continental schools; health, food and care seminar; exchange with other IALAs.
data.why_it_matters: Women-centered political-pedagogical and agroecological formation process in Chile, linking peasant feminism, seed sovereignty, popular education and territorial practice.
data.caution: Public sources describe events and intent more strongly than curriculum governance, participant selection, completion, outcomes, land control, budget or maintenance.

data.title: FENSUAGRO / IALA María Cano
data.what_it_curates: FENSUAGRO declarations and alerts; IALA María Cano school records; Raúl Valbuena training farm; participatory-action research exchanges; UNDROP audiograms; CLOC and La Vía Campesina reporting.
data.why_it_matters: Colombian national agricultural union federation linked to La Vía Campesina, paired with a movement-run agroecology institute in Viotá that combines political formation, professional learning, territorial research and peasant rights education.
data.caution: Conflict-sensitive source system. Public visibility can expose people and territories; historical and current roles must be dated. Organizer reports establish activity and threats but do not independently validate governance or outcomes.

data.title: FENSUAGRO / IALA María Cano
data.what_it_curates: CLOC reports, school exchanges, union materials, declarations and participatory-action research records.
data.why_it_matters: Colombian peasant/agricultural-worker federation and affiliated movement-education infrastructure within CLOC-LVC.
data.caution: Security-sensitive context; avoid exposing local people or territories; organizer claims need triangulation. | Workflow status: Selected

data.title: FENSUAGRO Peasant Rights and Human-Rights Archive
data.steward: FENSUAGRO Peasant Rights and Human-Rights Archive
data.what_it_curates: UN complaints; La Vía Campesina solidarity reports; FENSUAGRO communiqués; UNDROP audiograms; peace-process and agrarian-reform materials.
data.why_it_matters: Distributed collection of declarations, complaints, alerts, UN interventions and educational media documenting peasant rights, agrarian reform demands, violence, threats and organizational defense.
data.caution: Do not expose local identities or operational details beyond public sources. Counts of threats or killings are date-bound and require careful attribution. Advocacy archives are not neutral incident databases.

data.title: g0v (gov-zero)
data.what_it_curates: Manifesto; project portfolio; hackathons; newcomer guides; GitHub repositories; civic tools; language and data projects; community documentation.
data.why_it_matters: Taiwan-based open-collaboration community whose autonomous projects, hackathons, documentation and open-source outputs connect civic problems, citizen participation, public data and digital services.
data.caution: g0v has no single center or representative. Do not attribute every project or public-policy outcome to Audrey Tang, a unified organization, or the whole community.

data.title: Giveth
data.what_it_curates: Project directory; project updates; verification; GIVeconomy; GIVbacks; GIVpower; GIVstream; matching pools; DeVouch.
data.why_it_matters: Public-goods donation platform connecting project discovery, verification, donor rewards, project boosting, quadratic funding, and community trust signals.
data.caution: Verification and boosting are platform-specific signals, not proof of impact. Distinguish current and deprecated components.

data.title: Global Indigenous Data Alliance (GIDA)
data.what_it_curates: CARE Principles; Indigenous Peoples’ Rights in Data; history and network map; communiqués; IEEE provenance work; global and regional data-sovereignty networks; IDSov and AI convenings.
data.why_it_matters: An international Indigenous-led network advancing Indigenous Data Sovereignty and governance, collective rights and interests in data, and data for self-determined wellbeing.
data.caution: Do not reduce Indigenous data governance to generic privacy, ethics, or open-data compliance. GIDA is a network, not a universal representative of all Indigenous Peoples or communities.

data.title: Global Tapestry of Alternatives
data.what_it_curates: Weavers and endorsers; facilitation team; assemblies; working and thematic groups; Weaving Alternatives periodical; reports; collaborative documentation and mapping; declarations; dialogues; multilingual and visual materials.
data.why_it_matters: A global process launched in 2019 that connects and nurtures interactions, learning and collaboration among autonomous regional and thematic networks of alternatives without claiming to be their representative center.
data.caution: Do not treat GTA as owner, validator or representative of alternatives. Preserve weaver authority, source language, territorial context, disagreement, security and choices not to be mapped.

data.title: IALA María Cano / Finca-Escuela Raúl Valbuena
data.steward: IALA María Cano / Finca-Escuela Raúl Valbuena
data.what_it_curates: School launches; cohort and curriculum reports; field practice; IALA exchanges; participatory-action research; communication-school hosting; UNDROP education materials.
data.why_it_matters: Agroecology institute and farm-school located in Viotá, Cundinamarca, developed through FENSUAGRO and the CLOC-LVC IALA network for peasant, Indigenous and Afro-descendant youth and movement members.
data.caution: Public sources are stronger on founding intent and events than on current governance, accreditation, funding, participant selection, completion, alumni outcomes or land and maintenance arrangements.

data.title: IALA-PR / Instituto para la Investigación y Acción en Agroecología
data.steward: IALA-PR / Instituto para la Investigación y Acción en Agroecología
data.what_it_curates: Programs; land-access campaign; agroecology trust; market map; research-action accompaniment; schools, wellbeing and solidarity-economy initiatives.
data.why_it_matters: Puerto Rico-based institute supporting agroecological initiatives through participatory action research, administrative and economic support, training, land access and physical resources.
data.caution: Distinct from Organización Boricuá and from the continental IALA schools. Current governance, funding, land holdings, beneficiaries and program outcomes require direct documentation.

data.title: IARAA — Inteligência Artificial da Reforma Agrária e Agroecologia
data.steward: IARAA — Inteligência Artificial da Reforma Agrária e Agroecologia
data.what_it_curates: Three user modes; curated agroecology corpus; RAGFlow and custom Meta-RAG retrieval; named language-model dependency; corpus contribution and oral-knowledge systematization; terms and privacy; governance; field testing; maintenance; correction and safety.
data.why_it_matters: Live beta knowledge assistant developed through MST, the World March of Women and the International Association for Popular Cooperation (Baobab), intended to support agroecology, popular agrarian reform and technological sovereignty.
data.caution: Current public evidence confirms a live beta, broad architecture and organizer-stated principles, but not the full corpus inventory, permissions, decision rights, evaluation, incident handling, infrastructure ownership or independent outcomes.

data.title: Institutos Agroecológicos Latinoamericanos (IALA) Network
data.what_it_curates: IALA María Cano; Mamá Tingó; Ixim Ulew; Sembradoras de Esperanza; Guaraní; Paulo Freire; ELAA; IALA Amazônico; participatory-action research; political-pedagogical commissions.
data.why_it_matters: Network of movement-run agroecology institutes and schools connected to CLOC–La Vía Campesina, using popular education, farmer-to-farmer learning and political-professional formation.
data.caution: Current institute count, names, status and governance vary over time. Do not infer equivalent curricula, authority, resources or outcomes across the network.

data.title: International Center for Community Land Trusts
data.steward: International Center for Community Land Trusts
data.what_it_curates: Curated library, manuals, case studies, histories, publisher and technical-support programs
data.why_it_matters: International; multilingual resources
data.caution: Resource center can document models and cases, but local governance, affordability and resident power require case-level evidence | Workflow status: Selected in final bounded source-system expansion

data.title: International Planning Committee for Food Sovereignty (IPC)
data.steward: International Planning Committee for Food Sovereignty (IPC)
data.what_it_curates: Nyéléni preparatory process; regional and constituency consultations; movement coordination; global forums; food-sovereignty policy engagement; liaison with FAO and related bodies.
data.why_it_matters: Coordinates small-scale food-producer and civil-society movements around food sovereignty and serves as a liaison with UN food and agriculture institutions.
data.caution: Do not treat IPC as replacing or speaking uniformly for autonomous participating movements. Current structure, representation and decision rights require direct governance review.

data.title: IT for Change
data.what_it_curates: Research programmes; Feminist Digital Justice; Digital Justice Project; policy advocacy; training; feminist AI; platform economy and digital-development analysis.
data.why_it_matters: India-based research and advocacy organization developing Southern feminist and social-justice perspectives on digital transformation, data, AI, platforms, labor, governance and development sovereignty.
data.caution: Research and advocacy positions are situated and normative; do not treat IT for Change as representing all feminist or Global South perspectives.

data.title: IWGIA Territorial Governance Programme
data.what_it_curates: Documentation, publications, rights monitoring, territorial-governance support and advocacy
data.why_it_matters: Global Indigenous Peoples; country and regional programs
data.caution: IWGIA is a support and documentation organization, not a substitute for the authority of Indigenous governments and communities | Workflow status: Selected in final bounded source-system expansion

data.title: Kalpavriksh
data.what_it_curates: Alternatives programme; publications and reports; team; environmental justice; conservation and livelihoods; community governance; education; Vikalp Sangam; Global Tapestry of Alternatives; radical ecological democracy.
data.why_it_matters: Indian environmental action group working across ecological sustainability, social equity, biodiversity, conservation, environmental education and alternatives, while helping steward Vikalp Sangam and GTA-related work.
data.caution: Separate Kalpavriksh-authored positions from collective Vikalp Sangam or GTA outputs. Organizational continuity does not establish movement representation or validate every documented alternative.

data.title: Karnataka Rajya Raitha Sangha / Amrita Bhoomi
data.steward: Karnataka Rajya Raitha Sangha / Amrita Bhoomi
data.what_it_curates: KRRS movement lineage; Amrita Bhoomi Learning Centre; agroecology training; natural farming; women and youth leadership; farmer exchanges; food sovereignty.
data.why_it_matters: Indian farmer-movement lineage combining agrarian organizing, agroecology, social justice and farmer-to-farmer education through Amrita Bhoomi.
data.caution: Public English documentation is partial and often mediated through international movement sources. Current governance, curriculum and participant outcomes need direct local review.

data.title: La Vía Campesina
data.what_it_curates: International conferences and declarations; regional member movements; agroecology; food sovereignty; peasant seeds; UNDROP; women, youth and diversity assemblies; training materials; podcasts and publications.
data.why_it_matters: Connects food sovereignty, peasant agroecology, seeds, land and water, peasants' rights, climate justice, migrant and rural labor, women, youth and territorial knowledge through a transnational movement structure.
data.caution: Do not treat the international movement as a single homogeneous voice or infer that every member organization endorses every statement. Preserve regional, constituency and local autonomy.

data.title: Laws of Social Reproduction Project
data.what_it_curates: Lectures; publications; research notes; teaching resources; contemporary feminist analyses of social reproduction.
data.why_it_matters: Interdisciplinary project focused on social reproduction, law, labor, care, feminist political economy and collective struggle.
data.caution: Academic framing should not replace worker, caregiver, movement or community knowledge; licensing and context vary by artifact.

data.title: Local Contexts
data.what_it_curates: Local Contexts Hub; TK Labels; BC Labels; Notices; Projects; Registry; API; governance documents; community, institution, researcher and integration-partner accounts; training and implementation resources.
data.why_it_matters: Indigenous-led digital infrastructure that enables communities to express authority, protocols, permissions and responsibilities for cultural heritage, data, genetic resources and biocultural collections.
data.caution: Labels are community tools and Notices are institution/researcher tools. Applying an icon or notice is not consent, ownership transfer, consultation completion, or proof of ethical practice.

data.title: Metagov / Governance Research Network
data.what_it_curates: Metagov community and seminar; Govbase; PolicyKit; DAOstar and EIP-4824; KOI Pond; Interoperable Deliberative Tools; Polycentricity; D20 Governance; gov/acc; Metagov Journal; OSS Transitions; Groundwork Fellowship; MetagovDAO; Public AI and AI Renaissance.
data.why_it_matters: A community of research and practice focused on tools, institutions, standards, datasets, experiments, and communities that enable self-governance in the digital age. It bridges governance research, online-community practice, civic and DAO tooling, field memory, and institutional experimentation.
data.caution: Metagov contains projects at different maturity states. A research prototype, seminar, dataset, standard, completed project, paused tool, or speculative governance experiment should not be treated as the same kind of evidence. Community participation and public archives also require privacy, consent, attribution, and status-sensitive interpretation.

data.title: Movimento dos Trabalhadores Rurais Sem Terra (MST)
data.steward: Movimento dos Trabalhadores Rurais Sem Terra (MST)
data.what_it_curates: Movement organization; settlements and camps; sectors and collectives; education system; ENFF; agroecology; cooperatives and agroindustries; health; women, youth and LGBTI+ organizing; publications and media; technological-sovereignty experiments.
data.why_it_matters: Mass social movement organized through territorial, state, regional and national structures, linking land struggle, popular agrarian reform, education, agroecology, cooperation, health, culture, communication and internationalism.
data.caution: Movement reporting and political claims require contextual and affected-party review. Do not reduce MST to one spokesperson, one sector or one universal model.

data.title: Mutual Aid Disaster Relief
data.what_it_curates: Disaster-response guides, safety resources, anti-oppression materials, infrastructure and direct-action education
data.why_it_matters: Primarily United States; networked solidarity practice
data.caution: Decentralized networks change quickly; public directories and guides do not verify every group, practice or safety condition | Workflow status: Selected in final bounded source-system expansion

data.title: Mutual Aid Disaster Relief
data.what_it_curates: Guiding principles; workshop guides; community relief practice; disaster mutual-aid resources; network relationships.
data.why_it_matters: Grassroots disaster-relief network grounded in solidarity, autonomous direct action, horizontal organizing and community-led response.
data.caution: Mutual aid should not be romanticized as a substitute for public responsibility, durable funding, safety, or accountable institutions.

data.title: Nyéléni International / Nyéléni Process
data.what_it_curates: 2007 Food Sovereignty Forum; 2015 Agroecology Forum; 2025 Global Forum; declarations; newsletters; preparatory documents; women and youth statements; Common Political Action Agenda.
data.why_it_matters: Preserves declarations, newsletters, preparatory consultations, constituency assemblies and common political agendas generated by peasants, Indigenous Peoples, pastoralists, fishers, workers, feminists, youth and allied movements.
data.caution: Declarations are collective political documents, not evidence that all proposals were implemented or that every constituency held identical positions.

data.title: Organización Boricuá de Agricultura Ecológica
data.what_it_curates: Mission and history; ecological certification; solidarity brigades; climate and disaster response; public blog; La Vía Campesina and CLOC materials; farmer education and seed work.
data.why_it_matters: Puerto Rico-wide movement network founded in 1989 and composed of farmers, farmworkers, agrarian organizers, agroecology promoters and food-sovereignty and climate-justice activists across urban, rural and coastal territories.
data.caution: Public documentation is fragmented and unevenly current. Do not infer formal authority, active membership, or present governance from historical blog posts or umbrella reporting.

data.title: Organización Boricuá de Agricultura Ecológica
data.what_it_curates: CLOC records, movement publications, public events and partner archives.
data.why_it_matters: Puerto Rican agroecology and food-sovereignty network connected to CLOC-LVC and island territorial practice.
data.caution: Public documentation is fragmented; colonial and disaster context must not be reduced to resilience branding. | Workflow status: Selected; direct-source discovery required

data.title: Participedia
data.what_it_curates: Cases; methods; organizations; collections; research clusters; teaching resources; downloadable data.
data.why_it_matters: Global crowdsourcing platform and research network documenting cases, methods, organizations and collections related to public participation and democratic innovation.
data.caution: Crowdsourced content varies in completeness and review depth; coverage reflects contributor, language and funding patterns.

data.title: People Powered
data.what_it_curates: Training; practical resources; accelerator and support programs; member network; regional implementation cases.
data.why_it_matters: Global hub helping organizations and governments build participatory budgeting, policymaking, planning, citizens’ assemblies and related practices.
data.caution: Program self-reports require case-level outcome review; support activity is not itself evidence of democratic impact.

data.title: Platform Cooperativism Consortium / Institute for the Cooperative Digital Economy
data.steward: Platform Cooperativism Consortium / Institute for the Cooperative Digital Economy
data.what_it_curates: Platform co-op resource library; ICDE research; fellows; conferences; Platform Co-op School; business-support and policy materials; global project network.
data.why_it_matters: Active global research, education, organizing, and business-support hub for worker- and user-owned digital platforms and cooperative digital infrastructure.
data.caution: PCC-reported project and worker-reach figures are organizer claims. Cooperative legal form does not by itself establish meaningful worker power, equitable outcomes, viability, or maintenance.

data.title: REDES A.C.
data.what_it_curates: Community and Indigenous concessions; spectrum and regulatory advocacy; emergency communications; community intranets; own-content production; training resources; publications.
data.why_it_matters: Mexican civil association supporting community and Indigenous communication, technological autonomy, policy advocacy, locally produced content and territorial collaboration.
data.caution: Public extraction must respect community authority, collective rights, language, cultural protocols and the distinction between REDES A.C. and the communities it accompanies.

data.title: Regen Network / Regen Registry
data.what_it_curates: Regen Registry; Registry Handbook and Program Guide; credit protocols and methodologies; project and credit-class records; Regen Ledger; ecocredit module; data module; marketplace; governance and validation/verification processes.
data.why_it_matters: Ecological asset registry, standards-development environment, technical ledger, and public library connecting methodologies, project registration, monitoring, reporting, verification, credit issuance, ecological data, and market infrastructure.
data.caution: Registry status, on-chain issuance, data anchoring, attestations, verification, and credit retirement each mean different things. None alone proves ecological outcomes, community legitimacy, additionality, permanence, or equitable benefit sharing. Place-based and Indigenous knowledge requires consent and context.

data.title: Research ICT Africa
data.what_it_curates: After Access; RAMP; AI and advanced technology policy; data policy; digital economy and indicators; DPI; capacity building; African regional policy research.
data.why_it_matters: African research network producing multidisciplinary evidence on access, digital inequality, data governance, AI, digital public infrastructure, regulation, indicators and digital development.
data.caution: Research findings depend on country, method, data availability and political context; do not generalize Africa as a single policy environment.

data.title: Rhizomatica
data.what_it_curates: Community mobile telephony; HERMES HF radio; Techio Comunitario; Indigenous Network Technician training; decentralized telecom and energy systems; policy and regulatory work.
data.why_it_matters: Supports communities to build and maintain self-governed communication and energy infrastructure through appropriate technology, regulatory work, training and direct accompaniment.
data.caution: Support organizations must not be represented as owners or representatives of community systems. Technical success does not establish cultural fit, consent, affordability or durable governance.

data.title: RIPESS Intercontinental Network
data.what_it_curates: Directories, thematic resources, policy materials, news, events and member-network pathways
data.why_it_matters: Global; continental member networks
data.caution: Network self-description and curated resources are authoritative for identity and discovery, not independent proof of member practice or outcomes | Workflow status: Selected in final bounded source-system expansion

data.title: Sins Invalid
data.what_it_curates: 10 Principles of Disability Justice; movement resources; access guides; performance and cultural work; climate, language, reproductive, anti-carceral and international solidarity materials.
data.why_it_matters: Disabled-led movement and performance project that helped articulate disability justice, centering disabled Black, Indigenous, queer, trans, nonbinary and other people of color and linking access to collective liberation.
data.caution: Do not reduce disability justice to accessibility compliance or universal-design checklists. Sins Invalid is a movement source, not a certification body, and its principles require contextual and community-led interpretation.

data.title: The Commoner — Care Work and the Commons Archive
data.steward: The Commoner — Care Work and the Commons Archive
data.what_it_curates: Care Work and the Commons issue; classic and contemporary essays; interviews; documents; commons and feminist political economy.
data.why_it_matters: Commons journal archive containing a substantial thematic issue on care work, domestic labor and social reproduction.
data.caution: Archive is uneven in date and context; use for lineage and framing, then verify current practice through contemporary primary sources.

data.title: The Maintainers
data.what_it_curates: Research agenda; community framework; fellowships; study guide; essays; conferences; practitioner network; maintenance, repair, and care cases.
data.why_it_matters: Global research and practice network and resource archive centered on maintenance, repair, care, infrastructure, and the labor that sustains human-built systems.
data.caution: The site states that grant-funded organizational operations closed while the network and resources continue. Treat it as a current network/archive, not an active staffed institution unless independently confirmed.

data.title: União Nacional das Cooperativas da Reforma Agrária Popular do Brasil (UNICRAB)
data.steward: União Nacional das Cooperativas da Reforma Agrária Popular do Brasil (UNICRAB)
data.what_it_curates: Member cooperatives and associations; annual meetings; productive chains; agroindustries; territorial support; policy engagement; cooperative education; market coordination.
data.why_it_matters: National network connecting cooperatives and associations linked to agrarian reform, healthy-food production, agroecology, processing and market coordination.
data.caution: Membership and scale figures are organizer-reported and vary by date. Cooperative registration does not by itself establish democratic rules-in-use, equitable labor or livelihood outcomes.

data.title: Vikalp Sangam
data.what_it_curates: Stories and case materials; regional and thematic Sangams; Alternatives Framework; Alternatives Transformation Format; organizations and initiatives; videos and interviews; multilingual publications; statements; annual and national gatherings.
data.why_it_matters: An evolving Indian Alternatives Confluence launched in 2014 that documents, convenes and connects movements and organizations exploring ecologically sustainable, socially just and democratic pathways.
data.caution: The platform and facilitators should not displace featured communities or movements. Preserve authorship, location, language, source organization, internal disagreement and limits of self-reported cases.

data.title: Voz Campesina / CLOC–Radio Mundo Real media collaboration
data.steward: Voz Campesina / CLOC–Radio Mundo Real media collaboration
data.what_it_curates: Audio editions; interviews; congress coverage; women, youth and diversity articulations; regional reporting; communication-school outputs.
data.why_it_matters: Long-running audio program jointly produced by CLOC–La Vía Campesina and Radio Mundo Real, connecting movement voices, regional struggles, assemblies and political education.
data.caution: Broadcast visibility does not establish representative authority. Episodes require dated role, language, consent and archival-status review before reuse.

data.title: Workshop on Governing Knowledge Commons
data.what_it_curates: GKC framework; publications; cases; researchers; teaching resources; network and programs.
data.why_it_matters: Research and publication system organizing empirical study of institutions for sharing knowledge, data, science, innovation and culture.
data.caution: Academic research requires contextual translation; a framework or case finding is not a universal prescription.

data.title: Zenzeleni Community Networks
data.what_it_curates: Community cooperatives; nonprofit support entity; hotspots; dedicated access; cooperative seeding; policy submissions; practical guides; evidence and learning resources.
data.why_it_matters: South African community-network model combining locally governed cooperative internet service providers with a supporting nonprofit company, practical resources, policy advocacy and local services.
data.caution: Community ownership should be verified through actual decision rights, benefit distribution, labor, maintenance and community perspectives. Awards and connectivity metrics are not outcome proof.

data.title: ZIMSOFF / Shashe Agroecology School
data.what_it_curates: ZIMSOFF; Shashe Agroecology School; seed fairs; territorial learning; women and youth participation; land reform context; agroecological production.
data.why_it_matters: Zimbabwean smallholder farmer organization and school network combining agroecology, seed sovereignty, women’s leadership and farmer-to-farmer exchange.
data.caution: Current school status, governance, funding and participant-level outcomes require direct follow-up. Do not infer that one school represents all ZIMSOFF members.
